title: Young's gilley show and the move to Mrs. Young's big show
summary: Young runs a small gilley show in Illinois while Mrs. Young runs a separate one; he hands his show to the barker Kitchen and takes Phillips and Pete Jones, the best players, to her show, which closes in Oklahoma in November 1926.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: But anyway, we went up to this little show that Mr. Young had up there in Illinois. What we called a Gilley Show. That's one of them shows... It's a small show that travels... It don't travel with Pullman cars and wagons... Like a circus. You've seen a circus, how they travel. Well, that's the way that carnival traveled.
So he put you on a gilley show.
Yeah. That's where he was. But Mrs. Young was on another show.
Oh, she had left by that time.
No. See, they had two shows. That's where they worked. She'd have a show and he'd have a show.
But they traveled together.
No.
Oh, they traveled separately.
Yeah, separate shows. Separate companies.
Phillips - 47
Who was with her? Did all the kids stay with one of them, or did they split?
Lee and Irma was with her.
And Lester was with Willis.
Yeah. So this show got to not makin' no money or nothin', so...
You were on the show with Lester, right?
Yeah. Lester and I was on there, and Pete and all of us was on the same show.
This is early '26.
Yeah. So he was going... He said, "Deak, you and Pete, I'm gonna take you all with me. I'm going over with Miss Young." He said, "I'm going to leave this show here with Kitchen."
Kitchen?
Yeah. That was a man out there who was a spieler.
He was the barker.
The barker, yeah.
The barker's name was Kitchen.

Yeah. He said, "I'm going to turn this show over to Kitchen and let him take it." So he turned it over to him, and he took me... Miss Young had this big show, Likeman(?) and Carson. So we went over to that show, and he took me and Pete with him, and Les... Lester had already gone
Phillips - 48
there before we got there. I know why he did it, though...
Because Lester had already gone over there on his own.
No. He sent over there to his mother. She had a show, and he sent him over to the big show. So he was going...
But you were going to say you knew why he had gone.

No, I was saying I knew why he had taken us, me and Pete. Because we were the best players, and he wanted to take us with him. We joined the show from Carbondale, Illinois, I think it was. That's where we left from. And we went over to the show with Miss Young -- on the show with her. And we stayed on that show until it closed. That show closed in Elrino, Oklahoma.
When did it close?
That was 1926.
What part of the year?
All the shows closed in the fall. So this was in November -- the latter part of November. While I was on that show, he was rehearsing a dance band.
